title: erodium atlanticum var. cossonii
intro: Erodium atlanticum var. cossonii, commonly known as the "Spanish isoplex", is a species of herbaceous perennial plant in the family Geraniaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Erodium atlanticum var. cossonii include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory effects. The health benefits of this plant also include its potential to reduce oxidative stress and improve cardiovascular health.
